lines.text: Count by tens from zero, then look between the marks.
Tap the line where 0 point 3 goes. Then launch!
Tap the line where 100 goes. Then launch!
Tap the line where 18 goes. Then launch!
Tap the line where 5 goes. Then launch!
Tap the line where 66 goes. Then launch!
Tap the line where 7 goes. Then launch!
Tap the line where five sixths goes. Then launch!
Tap the line where negative 40 goes. Then launch!
Tap the line where the square root of 62 goes. Then launch!
The marks count by 25. Tap the line where 183 goes. Then launch!
